AI in regard to coding essentially makes small apps easy to make and thus eliminated the value of small apps. I have seen many apps over the years that were built by an employee and solved a business problem perfectly but as it grew real devs had to be brought in to make it scale. AI can help you build that small concept. but it will fail if it grows. 85% of apps built by pros failed to scale. refactoring an AI created design pattern to be more efficient is something AI currently will not do well at the hands of a junior or non developer. all apps must undergo some form of refactor as it grows to survive. sometimes the way to make it work can be a bit mind bending and require some seriously out of the box thinking that AI will never do EVER! I can say this confidently since AI is essentially all about being in the box. AI is the box.

I've gotten better but still dislike the lead up to a technical interview all because of that first fumble.
